name: jellite
description: API-only, Jellyfin-compatible music server backed by Google Drive + SQLite, deployed on Cloud Run.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace sync
scripts.backend: npm run build --workspace backend && node backend/dist/server.js
scripts.unraid-sync: npm run build --workspace sync && node sync/dist/index.js --library-root /mnt/user/music/LOSSLESS --playlists-dir /mnt/user/music/LOSSLESS/playlists --drive-folder-id 1VO32-V4DGRr2WzG-boZAqo3Wmo9nHh1i --db data/jellite.sqlite --oauth-token-file ./.oauth-token.json
scripts.macos-sync: npm run build --workspace sync && node sync/dist/index.js --library-root /Volumes/music/LOSSLESS --playlists-dir /Volumes/music/LOSSLESS/playlists --drive-folder-id 1VO32-V4DGRr2WzG-boZAqo3Wmo9nHh1i --db data/jellite.sqlite --oauth-token-file ./.oauth-token.json
